meta.title: Who It's For
meta.description: Loquor AAC serves communicators of all ages, speech-language pathologists, caregivers, and educators.

hero.title: Built for People Who
hero.description: Loquor AAC serves communicators of all ages and abilities, along with the clinicians, caregivers, and educators who support them.

audiences.title: Adults with Acquired Conditions
audiences.conditions: ALS, stroke, aphasia, TBI, dysarthria, apraxia
audiences.description: For adults who have lost or are losing the ability to speak, Loquor AAC offers efficient text input with predictive suggestions, quick access to common phrases, and high-quality voice output that helps preserve communication identity.
highlights: Fast text typing with word predictions
Customizable phrase libraries for daily routines
Premium AI voices for natural-sounding speech
Offline capability for reliable communication anywhere

audiences.title: Children and Pre-Literate Communicators
audiences.conditions: Autism, cerebral palsy, developmental delays, intellectual disabilities
audiences.description: Symbol-based communication with stable, motor-planning friendly layouts that support learning. The progressive vocabulary system grows with the child, and the child-friendly theme makes the experience engaging.
highlights: Pictogram symbols with stable grid positions for muscle memory
Progressive 6-level vocabulary that grows with the child
Child-friendly theme with large, colorful tap targets
Fitzgerald Key color-coding for visual grammar learning

audiences.title: Speech-Language Pathologists
audiences.description: Advanced grammar controls, three assist levels (Simple, Standard, Expert), and comprehensive admin tools give SLPs the precision they need. Vocabulary statistics and pack management streamline clinical workflows.
highlights: Three assist levels for different therapy stages
Grammar Bar with gender-aware article selection
Vocabulary statistics panel for tracking progress
Vocabulary Packs for structured language intervention

audiences.title: Caregivers and Family Members
audiences.conditions: Parents, guardians, home care, daily support
audiences.description: The 12-step guided setup wizard makes getting started simple - no technical expertise required. PIN protection keeps settings safe, while profile management lets caregivers manage multiple communicators on a single device.
highlights: 12-step guided setup wizard - no tech skills needed
PIN-protected admin to prevent accidental edits
Multi-user profiles for managing multiple communicators
Backup and restore to protect customizations

audiences.title: Educational Settings
audiences.description: The progressive vocabulary system and Fitzgerald Key visual learning aids make Loquor AAC ideal for educational environments. Activity Boards can be customized for classroom contexts.
highlights: Progressive vocabulary for structured learning paths
Fitzgerald Key color-coding teaches grammar visually
Activity Boards for classroom-specific contexts
High contrast and accessible design for all learners

cta.subtitle: Whether you're a communicator, caregiver, or clinician, we'd love to hear from you.
